items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury; third straight miss. Rookie Emmett Johnson starts in his place.
items.why: Groin strain; short week leads to caution after limited Tuesday practice.
items.implication: Full lead back role for Johnson with high touch volume expected vs Bills.
items.opportunity: RB1 workload and receiving role for backup; Chiefs run game continues without Walker.

items.text: Puka Nacua and TE Terrance Ferguson are out for the season per ETR Week 12 preview; Nacua underwent MCL surgery with 4-5 month recovery, missing regular season and playoffs.
items.why: MCL surgery recovery timeline confirmed via Schefter/McVay; ETR highlighted in pre-Week 12 notes.
items.implication: Rams WR corps thinned; look to remaining receivers and Kyren Williams for elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for healthy Rams pass-catchers and RB work.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries after re-aggravating in Week 11 loss.
items.why: Re-aggravated right ankle/foot; coach noted nothing major but practice impacted.
items.implication: Availability for Titans in doubt; monitor Friday for GTD or OUT; backup opportunity rises.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Chris Rodriguez if Tuten limited or out.
corroboration: ETR preview noting Tuten injury resurfaces

items.text: Levitan on Etienne/Saints: expects disappointing snaps and routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17. Recent snaps shared heavily with CJ Donaldson.
items.why: Cites Graziano report and recent snap data (32 snaps shared); timeshare history with Estime/Miller previously.
items.implication: Floor more carries-dependent; less receiving upside than hoped post-contract.
items.opportunity: Carry volume still playable but routes/snaps capped; Kamara limited.
items.conflict: Contract expectations vs actual committee usage.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy won't practice Wednesday with ankle sprain from Sunday night; day-to-day per Shanahan.
items.why: Ankle sprain suffered Q2 Sunday; short-term recovery uncertain.
items.implication: Potential backup start or limited if plays; impacts SF skill players.
items.opportunity: Monitor for inactive; Mac Jones or other if out.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/g) in two games with Jacoby Brissett vs under 6% (1.3 rec) prior; raises PPR floor significantly.
items.why: QB change unlocked more checkdowns/pass involvement.
items.implication: Safer RB1/2 floor in PPR; hold or start with confidence.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11 return; averages 36% on season and 50% of Eagles end-zone targets. Role elite despite injury-hit season.
items.why: Massive target share and red-zone work when healthy.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 if active; high upside.
items.opportunity: Dominant target share and end-zone looks.

items.text: Packers list Josh Jacobs (finger) questionable for Wednesday vs Rams; Micah Parsons activated from PUP and expected to debut (also Q but cleared).
items.why: Finger injury; limited practice. Parsons activated for expected debut.
items.implication: Monitor for Jacobs active/inactive; GB run game if out benefits others. Parsons boosts defense.
items.opportunity: Potential backup RB work if Jacobs sits.

items.text: Giants RB snaps last two weeks: Cam Skattebo 117, Singletary 16. Tracy (hamstring) eligible Week 13; Najee cut earlier. Skattebo dominating backfield.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with lead role; monitor Tracy return.

items.text: Berry puts Bo Nix on HATE list this week; expects heavy Jonah Coleman usage vs Steelers and insufficient Nix rushing to compensate. Outside top 20 QBs.
items.why: Matchup/run-game emphasis; limited observed rushing production from Nix.
items.implication: Sit in most formats; prefer other streaming QBs.

items.text: With Kyle Monangai back, D'Andre Swift dropped to 47% snaps and 39% rush attempts in Week 11; below 10% target share in 4/5 Monangai-active games. Now mid-low RB2.
items.implication: Lower ceiling/floor; flex rather than locked starter.

items.text: Ladd McConkey posted season-high 38% target share and 20.7 FP in return; averages 17.5 PPG when >=20% share. Health is the IF for solid option.
items.why: High target share when snaps available.

items.text: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) over last 2 with backup QBs but aDOT only 3 yards and 1 deep target; volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but efficiency down to 11.8 PPG avg.
items.why: High volume offset by short aDOT post-Brissett.
items.implication: Still startable TE1 but not elite ceiling.
items.opportunity: Safe volume floor, limited big-play upside.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka ranks last among 45 WRs with 50+ targets in YPT (5.0); under 50 rec yds since Week 3 and <12 PPR in 17/20 recent games. Levitan notes 41st in YPRR.
items.why: Poor efficiency metrics despite volume; QB/injury factors noted but production lagging.
